Title: The Square Rune
Texts: A rune pulses with a single number.
Only by speaking its square root will you reveal the hidden passage.

Title: The Twin Blades
Texts: Two rival blades lie before you.
To choose wisely, you must find the smaller blade and the difference in their power.

Title: The Prism
Texts: Three crystals shimmer with shifting hues.
Each glows with random RGB values, their combined light illuminating a hidden path.

Title: The Chronicle Stone
Texts: The stone whispers today’s day of the week.
Inscribe your event into it, and next time you return, it will remember.

Title: The Festival Countdown
Texts: A village elder asks: “When is the next holiday?”
Calculate how many days remain before celebration begins.

Title: The Mirror Sentence
Texts: Speak a sentence.
The Mirror of Shadows will echo it in reverse, testing your will.

Title: The Festival Countdown
Texts: A village elder asks: “When is the next holiday?”
Calculate how many days remain before celebration begins.

Title: The Palindrome Gate
Texts: A sealed gate only opens for words that read the same forward and backward. Speak carefully.

Title: The Whispering Tome
Texts: A tome demands a paragraph.
It counts how many times you utter a specific word before granting you knowledge.

Title: The Number Vault
Texts: Place 5 numbers into the vault.
To unlock its power, recall them in reverse order.

Title: The Song of Vowels
Texts: Speak a word. The spirits count the vowels within, their chorus growing stronger with each one.

Title: The Gathering of Names
Texts: You gather allies.
Add names one by one until you decide to stop.
Then, review the fellowship you’ve assembled, along with their number.
